research_scope: Fifteen base-game skills from PQ86-PQ100. Reward-slot and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved unless directly established.

duplicate_check.repository_search_note: All fifteen selected names were checked against the live repository before insertion. Charge and Flash Bomber were excluded because they already have canonical research batches.

records.name: Neo Wolf Fang Fist
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 86 — Yamcha is Number One
records.skill_description: An enhanced Wolf Fang Fist sequence that can be extended while the input is held.
records.mechanics_notes: Independent current reporting identifies the move as a Strike Super and describes an initial stamina cost that can increase as the attack is extended; exact canonical resource behavior should be audited further.

records.name: Atomic Blast
records.skill_description: Fires a concentrated Ki Blast attack at the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current PQ documentation confirms Atomic Blast as the PQ87 skill reward; the canonical cost is recorded as 100 Ki pending deeper technical reconciliation.

records.name: Buu Buu Ball
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 88 — Evil Seeks Dragon Balls Yet Again!
records.skill_description: Creates and launches a large Majin energy projectile.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ88 reward is independently confirmed. Exact technical behavior and reward-slot semantics remain unresolved in this batch.

records.name: Victory Rush
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 89 — Super-Super Ultimate Series of Battles!
records.skill_description: A rapid multi-hit rush attack ending in a powerful strike.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill references classify Victory Rush as a Strike Ultimate using 300 Ki; PQ89 is independently confirmed as an acquisition route.

records.name: III Bomber
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 90 — Gathering of the Great Evil Alliance
records.skill_description: Launches a sequence of Majin-style explosive projectiles.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ documentation names the reward III Bomber. Current skill references may spell the same skill as Ill Bomber; both naming forms are preserved as provenance rather than silently treating them as separate skills.

records.name: Final Kamehameha
records.skill_description: Fires a massive combined Final Flash/Kamehameha energy wave.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ91 is independently confirmed as an acquisition route. The skill is also associated with the TP Medal Shop; reward-slot semantics remain unresolved here.

records.name: Maiden Burst
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 92 — Revenge of the Tuffle
records.skill_description: Creates a defensive Ki explosion while evading an opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill references classify Maiden Burst as a Ki Blast Evasive using 300 stamina; PQ92 reward is independently confirmed.

records.name: Bluff Kamehameha
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 94 — Ultimate Power, Ultimate Saiyan
records.skill_description: Performs a fake Kamehameha that can manipulate the opponent rather than functioning as a conventional damaging beam.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific references classify Bluff Kamehameha as an Other Super using 100 Ki. PQ94 is independently confirmed as an acquisition route.

records.name: Drain Field
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 95 — Super 17, the Ultimate Android
records.skill_description: Creates an energy-draining field while evading attacks.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ95 independently lists Drain Field alongside Flash Bomber. Exact resource behavior and reward-slot semantics require further skill-specific reconciliation.

records.name: Absolute Zero
records.skill_description: Uses a defensive evasive technique that creates a freezing effect around the user.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ96 is independently confirmed as the acquisition route. Exact current resource and technical details remain subject to deeper audit.

records.name: Charged Ki Wave
records.skill_description: Charges and releases a controllable Ki wave.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ97 independently lists Charged Ki Wave. The exact charging behavior and current technical specification remain partially unresolved.

records.name: Phantom Fist
records.skill_description: A deceptive close-range strike that uses phantom-like movement to reach the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ97 independently lists Phantom Fist. Exact hit behavior and current technical fields remain partially unresolved.

records.name: Dimension Ray
records.skill_description: Fires a dimensional energy beam through a spatial rift.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ98 independently lists Dimension Ray. Exact technical behavior and reward-slot semantics remain unresolved.

records.name: Emperor's Edge
records.skill_description: Fires a precise Frieza-style energy attack at the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ99 independently lists Emperor's Edge. Exact current technical details remain partially unresolved.

records.name: X100 Big Bang Kamehameha
records.skill_description: Fires an enormous combined Big Bang Attack and Kamehameha energy wave.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ100 is independently confirmed as an acquisition route. The skill is also associated with the TP Medal Shop; exact reward-slot semantics remain unresolved.
